I haven't released the hold on C-2207. Priya placed it at 9:01 because three invoices are 60 days overdue, so lifting it needs her agreement.

I've messaged both of them:
- **Priya:** I asked her to confirm whether the hold stays or whether she and Dana agree on an exception.
- **Dana:** I told her the hold is still in place and that I'll release it as soon as Priya approves.

I also corrected my 9:01 reply. The hold tool only records the customer ID and on/off status, so the overdue reason is not on the account. It exists only in the chat.
